anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW connects only the anodes of D4, D14, and D23. There is no supply rail, pull-up, driver output, or other source connected to this net. The LED cathodes are tied through R10, R2, and R3 to active-low indicator signals, but the common anode node is floating.
anomalies.expected: A net named /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW that supplies common LED anodes should be connected to a 3.3 V supply or a driven LED-power control node so the LEDs have a forward voltage source. With no source, D4, D14, and D23 cannot illuminate.
anomalies.impact: The Ethernet/PI status LEDs D4, D14, and D23 are expected to remain dark because their common anode power net is floating and cannot provide the required forward bias.

parsed.summary: The design files support an anomaly: the LED common-anode power net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW is floating and connected only to D4, D14, and D23, so those status LEDs lack a supply and would not behave as intended.
